title: Over The Garden Wall Set For 2026 Return With “Expanded Edition Book”
content: Despite only having one season to its name, Over The Garden Wall has become one of the biggest animated original stories in Cartoon Network’s history. Every fall, the story of Gregory and Wirt is routinely revisited worldwide, with fans continuing to praise the series to this day.

content: A website opened on Thursday to announce the television anime adaptation of Shikiso Utsuzawa 's Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For! ( Shin no Seijo de Aru Watashi wa Tsuihō Saremashita ) light novel series, slated for debut in 2027.

title: Kusunoki's Flunking Her High School Glow-Up Manga Gets TV Anime
content: DMM Pictures announced on Thursday that Mitsuki Mii 's Kusunoki's Flunking Her High School Glow-Up ( Kusunoki-san wa Kōkō Debut ni Shippai Shite Iru ) manga is getting a television anime adaptation. The manga will star Yūto Uemura as Keisuke Shizuki and Tomori Kusunoki as Shizuka Kusunoki.
